startDialog.title: Creative Foraging Game
startDialog.subtitle: Session setup — runs in your browser
startDialog.localOnlyTitle: All session data stays on your device in the folder you choose.
startDialog.folderNoticeRest: This app runs entirely in your browser — there is no cloud server. When you click "Choose data folder", your browser will ask permission to read and write that folder. You must allow access so sessions and moves can be saved. Use Chrome or Edge on desktop for full support.
startDialog.folderOk: Folder connected — you can start the game.
startDialog.folderWarn: No folder yet — connect to continue.
startDialog.browserNoFolder: Your browser cannot pick a save folder. Use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on desktop.
startDialog.folderRequired: Choose a folder and allow the browser to save there before starting.

game.welcomeMessage:
Welcome to the creative game!

Your task is to move around blocks to create interesting and beautiful figures.

Everytime you have created a figure you like, tap on the gallery in the upper right corner in order to save your figure to the gallery.

The experiment proceeds through {{minutes}} minutes.

Tell the experimenter when you are ready for the practice round.
game.practiceDoneMessage:
This was the end of the practice round.

Let the experimenter know when you are ready to begin the actual experiment.
game.byeMessage: The experiment is done. Thank you very much for your participation!
game.postExperimentTitle: What would you like to do next?
